------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void runInMemory() {\n        boolean buildRight = type == JoinType.LEFT || right.rowCount() <= left.rowCount();\n this.type = type;\n        this.leftKeyNames = List.copyOf(leftKeyColumns);\n        this.rightKeyNames = List.copyOf(rightKeyColumns);\n        this.cfg = config == null ? new Config() : config;\n this.leftKeyIdx = left.schema().indicesOf(leftKeyColumns);\n        this.rightKeyIdx = right.schema().indicesOf(rightKeyColumns);\n    }\n\n    //    Spiller.SpillFile[] rw = new Spiller.SpillFile[topFanout];\n        try {\n            for (int p = 0; p < topFanout; p++) {\n                lw[p] = spiller.create(\"L0-\" + p + \".jsonl\");\n }\n                int p = partition(k, 0, topFanout);\n                lw[p].write(lr, i); // probe id = original left row index\n            }\n            for (Row rr : right.rows()) {\n f : rw) if (f != null) f.close();\n            spiller.cleanup();\n        }\n        return finish();\n    }\n\n    /** Describes what execute() would do without touching data or disk. */\n    public Map<String, Object> explain() {\n        Map<String, Object> plan = basePlan();\n        if (right.rowCount() == 0) {\n            plan.put(\"mode\", \"EMPTY_RIGHT\");\n        } else if (left.rowCount() == 0) {\n            plan.put(\"mode\", \"EMPTY_LEFT\");\n        } else if (left.rowCount() <= cfg.inMemoryRows && right.rowCount() <= cfg.inMemoryRows) {\n            plan.put(\"mode\", \"IN_MEMORY\");\n        } else {\n            plan.put(\"mode\", \"PARTITIONED_SPILL\");\n            topFanout = pickFanout(left.rowCount(), right.rowCount());\n        }\n        plan.put(\"fanout\", \"PARTITIONED_SPILL\".equals(plan.get(\"mode\")) ? topFanout : 0);\n        return plan;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> basePlan() {\n        Map<String, Object> plan = left rows with NULLs\");\n        plan.put(\"duplicateSemantics\", \"matching rows form a Cartesian product\");\n        plan.put(\"inMemoryRows\", cfg.inMemoryRows);\n        plan.put(\"diskBudgetBytes\",\n                cfg.diskBudgetBytes == Long.MAX_VALUE ? \"unlimited\" : cfg.diskBudgetBytes);\n        plan.put(\"maxRepartitionDepth\", cfg.maxRepartitionDepth);\n        plan.put(\"spillDir\", cfg.spillDir);\n        plan.put(\"buildSide\", type == JoinType.LEFT\n                ? \"right (inner table)\"\n                : (right.rowCount() <= left.rowCount() ? \"right (smaller)\" : \"left (smaller)\"));\n        plan.put(\"fallback\", \"block-nested-loops, chunk size \" + cfg.inMemoryRows\n                + \" rows; used when repartition cannot shrink a partition\");\n        return plan;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // In-memory join\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void runInMemory() {\n        boolean buildRight = type == JoinType.LEFT || right.rowCount() <= left.rowCount();\n        if (buildRight) {\n            Map<Key, List<Row>> ht = buildHashMap(right.rows(), rightKeyIdx, true);\n            BitSet matched = type == JoinType.LEFT ? new BitSet(left.rowCount()) : null;\n            for (int id = 0; id < left.rowCount(); id++) {\n                Row lr = left.rows().get(id);\n                Key k = Key.of(lr, leftKeyIdx);\n                if (k.hasNull()) {\n                    nullKeyLeftRows++;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                List<Row> hits = ht.get(k);\n                if (hits != null) {\n                    if (matched != null) matched.set(id);\n                    for (Row rr : hits) emitMatch(lr, rr);\n                }\n            }\n            if (type == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < left.rowCount(); i++) {\n                    if (!matched.get(i)) emitUnmatchedLeft(left.rows().get(i));\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // INNER only: smaller left side builds; null rows on either side are dropped.\n            Map<Key, List<Row>> ht = buildHashMap(left.rows(), leftKeyIdx, false);\n            for (Row rr : right.rows()) {\n                Key k = Key.of(rr, rightKeyIdx);\n                if (k.hasNull()) {\n                    nullKeyRightRows++;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                List<Row> hits = ht.get(k);\n                if (hits != null) for (Row lr : hits) emitMatch(lr, rr);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Map<Key, List<Row>> buildHashMap(List<Row> rows, List<Integer> keyIdx, boolean rightSide) {\n        Map<Key, List<Row>> ht = new HashMap<>();\n        for (Row r : rows) {\n            Key k = Key.of(r, keyIdx);\n            if (k.hasNull()) {\n                if (rightSide) nullKeyRightRows++;\n                else nullKeyLeftRows++;\n                continue;\n            }\n            ht.computeIfAbsent(k, x -> new ArrayList<>()).add(r);\n        }\n        return ht;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Partitioned spill join\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private long[] countRows(Spiller.SpillFile[] files) {\n        long[] counts = new long[files.length];\n        for (int p = 0; p < files.length; p++) counts[p] = Spiller.readAll(files[p].path()).size();\n        return counts;\n    }\n\n    private void processPartition(Path lPath, Path rPath, long lCount, long rCount,\n                                  int depth, BitSet matched) {\n        // Empty side -> no matches. LEFT unmatched rows are emitted by the\n        // top-level final pass over the original left table.\n        if (rCount == 0 || lCount == 0) return;\n\n        // Build side fits -> hash join this partition pair.\n        if (rCount <= cfg.inMemoryRows) {\n            List<Spiller.Envelope> rEnv = Spiller.readAll(rPath);\n            Map<Key, List<Spiller.Envelope>> ht = new HashMap<>();\n            for (Spiller.Envelope e : rEnv) {\n                ht.computeIfAbsent(Key.of(e.row(), rightKeyIdx), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(e);\n            }\n            try (BufferedReader br = Files.newBufferedReader(lPath, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {\n                String line;\n                while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {\n                    if (line.isEmpty()) continue;\n                    Map<String, Object> env = Json.parseObject(line);\n                    Row lr = Row.ofRaw(Json.getArray(env, \"row\"));\n                    int id = ((Number) env.get(\"id\")).intValue();\n                    List<Spiller.Envelope> hits = ht.get(Key.of(lr, leftKeyIdx));\n                    if (hits != null) {\n                        if (matched != null) matched.set(id);\n                        for (Spiller.Envelope> be : hits) emitMatch(lr, be.row());\n                    }\n                }\n            } catch (IOException e) {\n                throw new JoinException(JoinException.IO_ERROR,\n                        \"Failed reading spill file: \" + lPath, e);\n            }\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build side too large: split further or fall back.\n        if (depth >= cfg.maxRepartitionDepth) {\n            fallbackJoin(lPath, rPath, matched);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        int newDepth = depth + 1;\n        spillDepthReached = Math.max(spillDepthReached, newDepth);\n        repartitionCount++;\n        int fanout = pickFanout(lCount, rCount);\n        String tag = \"D\" + newDepth + \"-\" + Long.toHexString(UUID.randomUUID().getMostSignificantBits());\n        Spiller.SpillFile[] lw = new Spiller.SpillFile[fanout];\n        Spiller.SpillFile[] rw = new Spiller.SpillFile[fanout];\n        long[] lc = new long[fanout];\n        long[] rc = new long[fanout];\n        for (int p = 0; p < fanout; p++) {\n            lw[p] = spiller.create(tag + \"-L\" + p + \".jsonl\");\n            rw[p] = spiller.create(tag + \"-R\" + p + \".jsonl\");\n        }\n        partitionsCreated += fanout;\n        for (Spiller.Envelope e : Spiller.readAll(lPath)) {\n            int p = partition(Key.of(e.row(), leftKeyIdx), newDepth, fanout);\n            lw[p].write(e.row(), e.id());\n            lc[p]++;\n        }\n        for (Spiller.Envelope e : Spiller.readAll(rPath)) {\n            int p = partition(Key.of(e.row(), rightKeyIdx), newDepth, fanout);\n            rw[p].write(e.row(), e.id());\n            rc[p]++;\n        }\n        for (int p = 0; p < fanout; p++) {\n            lw[p].close();\n            rw[p].close();\n        }\n        for (int p = 0; p < fanout; p++) {\n            try {\n                processPartition(lw[p].path(), rw[p].path(), lc[p], rc[p], newDepth, matched);\n            } finally {\n                lw[p].delete();\n                rw[p].delete();\n            }\n            partitionsProcessed++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Bounded block-nested-loops fallback for hot partitions repartitioning\n     * cannot shrink. Reads the probe file once and the build (right) file in\n     * chunks of at most inMemoryRows rows, rescanning probe rows per chunk.\n     * Peak memory: one build chunk plus all probe rows of this partition -\n     * if that is itself too large to hold, chunks of probe rows are also\n     * streamed from disk (see {@link #fallbackJoinStreamed}), which is chosen\n     * automatically.\n     */\n    private void fallbackJoin(Path lPath, Path rPath, BitSet matched) {\n        fallbackCount++;\n        List<Spiller.Envelope> probeAll = Spiller.readAll(lPath);\n        try (BufferedReader br = Files.newBufferedReader(rPath, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {\n            List<Spiller.Envelope> chunk = new ArrayList<>(cfg.inMemoryRows);\n            String line;\n            while (true) {\n                chunk.clear();\n                while (chunk.size() < cfg.inMemoryRows && (line = br.readLine()) != null) {\n                    if (line.isEmpty()) continue;\n                    Map<String, Object> env = Json.parseObject(line);\n                    chunk.add(new Spiller.Envelope(\n                            Row.ofRaw(Json.getArray(env, \"row\")),\n                            ((Number) env.get(\"id\")).intValue()));\n                }\n                if (chunk.isEmpty()) break;\n                joinChunkAgainstProbe(chunk, probeAll, matched);\n            }\n        } catch (IOException e) {\n            throw new JoinException(JoinException.IO_ERROR,\n                    \"Block-nested-loops fallback failed reading \" + rPath, e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void joinChunkAgainstProbe(List<Spiller.Envelope> buildChunk,\n                                       List<Spiller.Envelope> probeRows, BitSet matched) {\n        Map<Key, List<Spiller.Envelope>> ht = new HashMap<>();\n        for (Spiller.Envelope e : buildChunk) {\n            ht.computeIfAbsent(Key.of(e.row(), rightKeyIdx), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(e);\n        }\n        for (Spiller.Envelope pe : probeRows) {\n            List<Spiller.Envelope> hits = ht.get(Key.of(pe.row(), leftKeyIdx));\n            if (hits != null) {\n                if (matched != null) matched.set(pe.id());\n                for (Spiller.Envelope be : hits) emitMatch(pe.row(), be.row());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Output and stats\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void emitMatch(Row l, Row r) {\n        Object[] out = new Object[l.size() + r.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < l.size(); i++) out[i] = l.get(i).raw();\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.size(); i++) out[l.size() + i] = r.get(i).raw();\n        collector.collect(Row.of(out));\n        outputRows++;\n    }\n\n    private void emitUnmatchedLeft(Row l) {\n        Object[] out = new Object[l.size() + right.schema().size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < l.size(); i++) out[i] = l.get(i).raw();\n        // trailing entries stay null\n        collector.collect(Row.of(out));\n        outputRows++;\n    }\n\n    private EngineOut finish() {\n        Map<String, Object> stats = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        stats.put(\"mode\", mode);\n        stats.put(\"leftInputRows\", left.rowCount());\n        stats.put(\"rightInputRows\", right.rowCount());\n        stats.put(\"outputRows\", outputRows);\n        stats.put(\"nullKeyLeftRows\", nullKeyLeftRows);\n        stats.put(\"nullKeyRightRows\", nullKeyRightRows);\n        stats.put(\"partitionsCreated\", partitionsCreated);\n        stats.put(\"partitionsProcessed\", partitionsProcessed);\n        stats.put(\"maxSpillDepthReached\", spillDepthReached);\n        stats.put(\"repartitions\", repartitionCount);\n        stats.put(\"fallbackBlockNestedLoops\", fallbackCount);\n        if (spiller != null) {\n            stats.put(\"spillFilesCreated\", spiller.fileCount());\n            stats.put(\"spillBytesWritten\", spiller.totalBytesWritten());\n            stats.put(\"spillDirectory\", spiller.directory().toString());\n        } else {\n            stats.put(\"spillFilesCreated\", 0);\n            stats.put(\"spillBytesWritten\", 0);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> plan = basePlan();\n        plan.put(\"mode\", mode);\n        plan.put(\"fanout\", topFanout);\n        return new EngineOut(plan, stats);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Hashing / partitioning\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private int pickFanout(long lRows, long rRows) {\n        long bigger = Math.max(lRows, rRows);\n        int f = (int) Math.ceil(bigger * 1.3 / (double) cfg.inMemoryRows);\n        return Math.max(MIN_FANOUT, Math.min(MAX_FANOUT, f));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Depth-seeded hash of a composite key. The seed changes per repartition\n     * depth so a bad collision at depth d does not repeat at depth d+1.\n     */\n    private int partition(Key k, int depth, int fanout) {\n        long h = mix((long) k.hashCode() + depthSeed(depth));\n        return Math.floorMod(h, fanout);\n    }\n\n    private static long depthSeed(int depth) {\n        long s = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;\n        for (int i = 0; i <= depth; i++) {\n            s = mix(s + (long) (i + 1) * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4FL);\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    private static long mix(long x) {\n        x ^= x >>> 33;\n        x *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccdL;\n        x ^= x >>> 33;\n        x *= 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53L;\n        x ^= x >>> 33;\n        return x;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_dfe97a278d33a8a0a52c7d44","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":6725,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":51000,"output_tokens":5894,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_nwtr0k8yos58erloan0h144e":{"content":"package partjoin;\n\nimport java.io.BufferedReader;\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.BitSet;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.UUID;\n\n/**\n * Single-node, in-memory-with-disk-spill partitioned hash join.\n *\n * Algorithm overview\n * ------------------\n *  1. If both relations fit within {@code inMemoryRows} rows, a plain\n *     in-memory hash join runs (smaller side builds the hash table for INNER;\n *     the right side always builds for LEFT).\n *  2. Otherwise both sides are partitioned on their key columns using a\n *     depth-seeded Fibonacci hash. Null-keyed rows never enter partitions:\n *     INNER drops them, LEFT emits the left row padded with nulls.\n *  3. Each partition pair is processed independently:\n *       - build side fitting in memory   -> hash join of that partition;\n *       - too large, depth not exhausted -> repartition (recursive split with\n *         a fresh seed) - uniform keys split, skew does not;\n *       - too large, depth exhausted    -> bounded block-nested-loops\n *         fallback, which never builds more than {@code inMemoryRows} rows,\n *         so a pathological all-hot-key partition can always be processed.\n *\n * Duplicate keys produce the Cartesian product naturally (build-side list per\n * key bucket; every probe row emits against every matching build row).\n *\n * Disk use is bounded by {@code diskBudgetBytes} via {@link Spiller}.\n */\npublic final class HashJoinEngine {\n\n    private static final int MAX_FANOUT = 64;\n    private static final int MIN_FANOUT = 4;\n\n    /** Tuning knobs for one engine instance. */\n    public static final class Config {\n        public int inMemoryRows = 1024;\n        public long diskBudgetBytes = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n        public int maxRepartitionDepth = 2;\n        public String spillDir = System.getProperty(\"java.io.tmpdir\", \"/tmp\")\n                + \"/partjoin-spill\";\n\n        public Config copy() {\n            Config c = new Config();\n            c.inMemoryRows = inMemoryRows;\n            c.diskBudgetBytes = diskBudgetBytes;\n            c.maxRepartitionDepth = maxRepartitionDepth;\n            c.spillDir = spillDir;\n            return c;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** Everything a run returns besides the streamed output rows. */\n    public static final class EngineOut {\n        public final Map<String, Object> plan;\n        public final Map<String, Object> stats;\n\n        EngineOut(Map<String, Object> plan, Map<String, Object> stats) {\n            this.plan = plan;\n            this.stats = stats;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---- request-level inputs ----\n    private final Table left;\n    private final Table right;\n    private final JoinType type;\n    private final List<String> leftKeyNames;\n    private final List<String> rightKeyNames;\n    private final Config cfg;\n\n    // ---- derived ----\n    private final List<Integer> leftKeyIdx;\n    private final List<Integer> rightKeyIdx;\n\n    // ---- run state ----\n    private RowCollector collector;\n    private Spiller spiller;\n    private int spillDepthReached;\n    private int repartitionCount;\n    private int fallbackCount;\n    private int partitionsCreated;\n    private int partitionsProcessed;\n    private long outputRows;\n    private long nullKeyLeftRows;\n    private long nullKeyRightRows;\n    private String mode;\n    private int topFanout;\n\n    public HashJoinEngine(Table left, Table right, JoinType type,\n                          List<String> leftKeyColumns, List<String> rightKeyColumns,\n                          Config config) {\n        this.left = left;\n        this.right = right;\n        this.type = type;\n        this.leftKeyNames = List.copyOf(leftKeyColumns);\n        this.rightKeyNames = List.copyOf(rightKeyColumns);\n        this.cfg = config == null ? new Config() : config;\n        if (leftKeyColumns.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new JoinException(JoinException.INVALID_REQUEST, \"At least one join key column is required\");\n        }\n        if (leftKeyColumns.size() != rightKeyColumns.size()) {\n            throw new JoinException(JoinException.INVALID_REQUEST,\n                    \"Left/right key column counts must match (\" + leftKeyColumns.size()\n                            + \" vs \" + rightKeyColumns.size() + \")\");\n        }\n        if (cfg.inMemoryRows < 1) {\n            throw new JoinException(JoinException.INVALID_REQUEST, \"inMemoryRows must be >= 1\");\n        }\n        if (cfg.maxRepartitionDepth < 0) {\n            throw new JoinException(JoinException.INVALID_REQUEST, \"maxRepartitionDepth must be >= 0\");\n        }\n        this.leftKeyIdx = left.schema().indicesOf(leftKeyColumns);\n        this.rightKeyIdx = right.schema().indicesOf(rightKeyColumns);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Public API\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    public EngineOut execute(RowCollector collector) {\n        this.collector = collector;\n\n        if (right.rowCount() == 0) {\n            mode = \"EMPTY_RIGHT\";\n            if (type == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                for (Row lr : left.rows()) {\n                    if (Key.of(lr, leftKeyIdx).hasNull()) nullKeyLeftRows++;\n                    emitUnmatchedLeft(lr);\n                }\n            }\n            return finish();\n        }\n        if (left.rowCount() == 0) {\n            mode = \"EMPTY_LEFT\";\n            return finish();\n        }\n\n        boolean fits = left.rowCount() <= cfg.inMemoryRows && right.rowCount() <= cfg.inMemoryRows;\n        if (fits) {\n            mode = \"IN_MEMORY\";\n            runInMemory();\n            return finish();\n        }\n\n        mode = \"PARTITIONED_SPILL\";\n        topFanout = pickFanout(left.rowCount(), right.rowCount());\n        Path spillRoot = Path.of(cfg.spillDir, \"spill-\" + UUID.randomUUID());\n        spiller = new Spiller(spillRoot, cfg.diskBudgetBytes);\n        BitSet matched = type == JoinType.LEFT ? new BitSet(left.rowCount()) : null;\n        Spiller.SpillFile[] lw = new Spiller.SpillFile[topFanout];\n        Spiller.SpillFile[] rw = new Spiller.SpillFile[topFanout];\n        try {\n            for (int p = 0; p < topFanout; p++) {\n                lw[p] = spiller.create(\"L0-\" + p + \".jsonl\");\n                rw[p] = spiller.create(\"R0-\" + p + \".jsonl\");\n            }\n            partitionsCreated += topFanout;\n            for (int i = 0; i < left.rowCount(); i++) {\n                Row lr = left.rows().get(i);\n                Key k = Key.of(lr, leftKeyIdx);\n                if (k.hasNull()) {\n                    nullKeyLeftRows++;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                int p = partition(k, 0, topFanout);\n                lw[p].write(lr, i); // probe id = original left row index\n            }\n            for (Row rr : right.rows()) {\n                Key k = Key.of(rr, rightKeyIdx);\n                if (k.hasNull()) {\n                    nullKeyRightRows++;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                int p = partition(k, 0, topFanout);\n                rw[p].write(rr, -1);\n            }\n            for (int p = 0; p < topFanout; p++) {\n                lw[p].close();\n                rw[p].close();\n            }\n\n            long[] lc = countRows(lw);\n            long[] rc = countRows(rw);\n\n            for (int p = 0; p < topFanout; p++) {\n                try {\n                    processPartition(lw[p].path(), rw[p].path(), lc[p], rc[p], 0, matched);\n                } finally {\n                    lw[p].delete();\n                    rw[p].delete();\n                }\n                partitionsProcessed++;\n            }\n\n            if (type == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < left.rowCount(); i++) {\n                    if (!matched.get(i)) emitUnmatchedLeft(left.rows().get(i));\n                }\n            }\n        } finally {\n            for (Spiller.SpillFile f : lw) if (f != null) f.close();\n            for (Spiller.SpillFile f : rw) if (f != null) f.close();\n            spiller.cleanup();\n        }\n        return finish();\n    }\n\n    /** Describes what execute() would do without touching data or disk. */\n    public Map<String, Object> explain() {\n        Map<String, Object> plan = basePlan();\n        if (right.rowCount() == 0) {\n            plan.put(\"mode\", \"EMPTY_RIGHT\");\n        } else if (left.rowCount() == 0) {\n            plan.put(\"mode\", \"EMPTY_LEFT\");\n        } else if (left.rowCount() <= cfg.inMemoryRows && right.rowCount() <= cfg.inMemoryRows) {\n            plan.put(\"mode\", \"IN_MEMORY\");\n        } else {\n            plan.put(\"mode\", \"PARTITIONED_SPILL\");\n            topFanout = pickFanout(left.rowCount(), right.rowCount());\n        }\n        plan.put(\"fanout\", \"PARTITIONED_SPILL\".equals(plan.get(\"mode\")) ? topFanout : 0);\n        return plan;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> basePlan() {\n        Map<String, Object> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        plan.put(\"joinType\", type.name());\n        plan.put(\"leftTable\", left.name());\n        plan.put(\"rightTable\", right.name());\n        plan.put(\"leftKeys\", leftKeyNames);\n        plan.put(\"rightKeys\", rightKeyNames);\n        plan.put(\"nullSemantics\", \"NULLs never match; INNER drops null-keyed rows, \"\n                + \"LEFT pads non-matching left rows with NULLs\");\n        plan.put(\"duplicateSemantics\", \"matching rows form a Cartesian product\");\n        plan.put(\"inMemoryRows\", cfg.inMemoryRows);\n        plan.put(\"diskBudgetBytes\",\n                cfg.diskBudgetBytes == Long.MAX_VALUE ? \"unlimited\" : cfg.diskBudgetBytes);\n        plan.put(\"maxRepartitionDepth\", cfg.maxRepartitionDepth);\n        plan.put(\"spillDir\", cfg.spillDir);\n        plan.put(\"buildSide\", type == JoinType.LEFT\n                ? \"right (inner table)\"\n                : (right.rowCount() <= left.rowCount() ? \"right (smaller)\" : \"left (smaller)\"));\n        plan.put(\"fallback\", \"block-nested-loops, chunk size \" + cfg.inMemoryRows\n                + \" rows; used when repartition cannot shrink a partition\");\n        return plan;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // In-memory join\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void runInMemory() {\n        boolean buildRight = type == JoinType.LEFT || right.rowCount() <= left.rowCount();\n        if (buildRight) {\n            Map<Key, List<Row>> ht = buildHashMap(right.rows(), rightKeyIdx, true);\n            BitSet matched = type == JoinType.LEFT ? new BitSet(left.rowCount()) : null;\n            for (int id = 0; id < left.rowCount(); id++) {\n                Row lr = left.rows().get(id);\n                Key k = Key.of(lr, leftKeyIdx);\n                if (k.hasNull()) {\n                    nullKeyLeftRows++;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                List<Row> hits = ht.get(k);\n                if (hits != null) {\n                    if (matched != null) matched.set(id);\n                    for (Row rr : hits) emitMatch(lr, rr);\n                }\n            }\n            if (type == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < left.rowCount(); i++) {\n                    if (!matched.get(i)) emitUnmatchedLeft(left.rows().get(i));\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // INNER only: smaller left side builds; null rows on either side are dropped.\n            Map<Key, List<Row>> ht = buildHashMap(left.rows(), leftKeyIdx, false);\n            for (Row rr : right.rows()) {\n                Key k = Key.of(rr, rightKeyIdx);\n                if (k.hasNull()) {\n                    nullKeyRightRows++;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                List<Row> hits = ht.get(k);\n                if (hits != null) for (Row lr : hits) emitMatch(lr, rr);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Map<Key, List<Row>> buildHashMap(List<Row> rows, List<Integer> keyIdx, boolean rightSide) {\n        Map<Key, List<Row>> ht = new HashMap<>();\n        for (Row r : rows) {\n            Key k = Key.of(r, keyIdx);\n            if (k.hasNull()) {\n                if (rightSide) nullKeyRightRows++;\n                else nullKeyLeftRows++;\n                continue;\n            }\n            ht.computeIfAbsent(k, x -> new ArrayList<>()).add(r);\n        }\n        return ht;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Partitioned spill join\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private long[] countRows(Spiller.SpillFile[] files) {\n        long[] counts = new long[files.length];\n        for (int p = 0; p < files.length; p++) counts[p] = Spiller.readAll(files[p].path()).size();\n        return counts;\n    }\n\n    private void processPartition(Path lPath, Path rPath, long lCount, long rCount,\n                                  int depth, BitSet matched) {\n        // Empty side -> no matches. LEFT unmatched rows are emitted by the\n        // top-level final pass over the original left table.\n        if (rCount == 0 || lCount == 0) return;\n\n        // Build side fits -> hash join this partition pair.\n        if (rCount <= cfg.inMemoryRows) {\n            List<Spiller.Envelope> rEnv = Spiller.readAll(rPath);\n            Map<Key, List<Spiller.Envelope>> ht = new HashMap<>();\n            for (Spiller.Envelope e : rEnv) {\n                ht.computeIfAbsent(Key.of(e.row(), rightKeyIdx), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(e);\n            }\n            try (BufferedReader br = Files.newBufferedReader(lPath, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {\n                String line;\n                while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {\n                    if (line.isEmpty()) continue;\n                    Map<String, Object> env = Json.parseObject(line);\n                    Row lr = Row.ofRaw(Json.getArray(env, \"row\"));\n                    int id = ((Number) env.get(\"id\")).intValue();\n                    List<Spiller.Envelope> hits = ht.get(Key.of(lr, leftKeyIdx));\n                    if (hits != null) {\n                        if (matched != null) matched.set(id);\n                        for (Spiller.Envelope> be : hits) emitMatch(lr, be.row());\n                    }\n                }\n            } catch (IOException e) {\n                throw new JoinException(JoinException.IO_ERROR,\n                        \"Failed reading spill file: \" + lPath, e);\n            }\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build side too large: split further or fall back.\n        if (depth >= cfg.maxRepartitionDepth) {\n            fallbackJoin(lPath, rPath, matched);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        int newDepth = depth + 1;\n        spillDepthReached = Math.max(spillDepthReached, newDepth);\n        repartitionCount++;\n        int fanout = pickFanout(lCount, rCount);\n        String tag = \"D\" + newDepth + \"-\" + Long.toHexString(UUID.randomUUID().getMostSignificantBits());\n        Spiller.SpillFile[] lw = new Spiller.SpillFile[fanout];\n        Spiller.SpillFile[] rw = new Spiller.SpillFile[fanout];\n        long[] lc = new long[fanout];\n        long[] rc = new long[fanout];\n        for (int p = 0; p < fanout; p++) {\n            lw[p] = spiller.create(tag + \"-L\" + p + \".jsonl\");\n            rw[p] = spiller.create(tag + \"-R\" + p + \".jsonl\");\n        }\n        partitionsCreated += fanout;\n        for (Spiller.Envelope e : Spiller.readAll(lPath)) {\n            int p = partition(Key.of(e.row(), leftKeyIdx), newDepth, fanout);\n            lw[p].write(e.row(), e.id());\n            lc[p]++;\n        }\n        for (Spiller.Envelope e : Spiller.readAll(rPath)) {\n            int p = partition(Key.of(e.row(), rightKeyIdx), newDepth, fanout);\n            rw[p].write(e.row(), e.id());\n            rc[p]++;\n        }\n        for (int p = 0; p < fanout; p++) {\n partjoin;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * Reference nested-loops join used solely as an oracle in tests.\n *\n * It is deliberately simple and independent of the hashing machinery:\n * every left/right pair is compared component by component using\n * {@link Value#equalsValue}, which encodes the NULL-never-matches rule and\n * numeric cross-type equality.\n */\npublic final class NestedLoopJoin {\n\n    private NestedLoopJoin() {\n    }\n\n    public static List<Row> join(Table left, Table right, JoinType type,\n                                 List<String> leftKeyColumns, List<String> rightKeyColumns) {\n        List<Integer> li = left.schema().indicesOf(leftKeyColumns);\n        List<Integer> ri = right.schema().indicesOf(rightKeyColumns);\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        for (Row l : left.rows()) {\n            boolean matched = false;\n            for (Row r : right.rows()) {\n                if (keysEqual(l, r, li, ri)) {\n                    out.add(concat(l, r));\n                    matched = true;\n                }\n            }\n            if (type == JoinType.LEFT && !matched) {\n                out.add(concatNulls(l, right.schema().size()));\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean keysEqual(Row l, Row r, List<Integer> li, List<Integer> ri) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < li.size(); i++) {\n            Value a = l.get(li.get(i));\n            Value b = r.get(ri.get(i));\n            if (!a.equalsValue(b)) return false; // covers NULL: null.equalsValue -> false\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    private static Row concat(Row l, Row r) {\n        Object[] out = new Object[l.size() + r.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < l.size(); i++) out[i] = l.get(i).raw();\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.size(); i++) out[l.size() + i] = r.get(i).raw();\n        return Row.of(out);\n    }\n\n    private static Row concatNulls(Row l, int rightWidth) {\n        Object[] out = new Object[l.size() + rightWidth];\n        for (int i = 0; i < l.size(); i++) out[i] = l.get(i).raw();\n        return Row.of(out);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"cb9369d5-8b12-4285-baf5-d2d50a2fec3e","session_id":"141270ed-bd67-4d73-9ed2-5fe1b950e0ba","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/b","sessionId":"141270ed-bd67-4d73-9ed2-5fe1b950e0ba","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-b","slug":"encapsulated-skipping-hammock"}

Long.MAX_VALUE : budget;\n        cfg.maxRepartitionDepth = Json.optInt(opts, \"maxRepartitionDepth\", cfg.maxRepartitionDepth);\n        cfg.spillDir = Json.optString(opts, \"spillDir\", cfg.spillDir);\n        int maxInline = Json.optInt(opts, \"maxInlineRows\", 10_000);\n\n        HashJoinEngine engine = new HashJoinEngine(left, right, type, leftKeys, rightKeys, cfg);\n\n        Map<String, Object> outputOpt = opts.get(\"output\") instanceof Map m ? castMap(m) : null;\n        RowCollector.FileCollector fileCollector = null;\n        RowCollector.ListCollector listCollector = null;\n        RowCollector collector;\n        Path outputPath = null;\n        String outputFormat = \"jsonl\";\n        if (outputOpt != null) {\n            outputPath = Path.of(Json.getString(outputOpt, \"path\"));\n            outputFormat = Json.optString(outputOpt, \"format\", \"jsonl\");\n            if (!outputFormat.equalsIgnoreCase(\"jsonl\") && }\n            fileCollector = new RowCollector.FileCollector(outputPath, outputFormat);\n            collector = fileCollector;\n        } else {\n            listCollector = new finally {\n            if (fileCollector != null) fileCollector.close();\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", true);\n        resp.put(\"plan\", out.plan);\n        resp.put(\"stats\", out.stats);\n\n        if (fileCollector != null) {\n            Map<String, Object> loc = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            loc.put(\"path\", outputPath.toAbsolutePath().toString());\n            loc.put(\"format\", outputFormat.toLowerCase());\n            loc.put(\"rows\", fileCollector.count());\n            resp.put(\"output\", loc);\n        } else {\n            List<Row> rows = listCollector.rows();\n            Map<String, Object> inline = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            List<String> outCols = new ArrayList<>();\n            outCols.addAll(left.schema().columns());\n            outCols.addAll(right.schema().columns());\n            inline.put(\"columns\", outCols);\n            boolean truncated = rows.size() > maxInline;\n            List<Object> arr = new ArrayList<>();\n            int limit = Math.min(rows.size(), maxInline);\n            for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) arr.add(rows.get(i).rawList());\n            inline.put(\"rows\", arr);\n            inline.put(\"rowCount\", rows.size());\n            inline.put(\"truncated\", truncated);\n            resp.put(\"output\", inline);\n        }\n\n        if (opts.get(\"planOutput\") instanceof Map po) {\n            Path planPath = Path.of(Json.getString(castMap(po), \"path\"));\n            writePlanFile(planPath, out.plan, out.stats);\n            resp.put(\"planOutput\", planPath.toAbsolutePath().toString());\n        }\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    /** Plan-only mode: validates Json.getStringList(req, \"leftKeys\");\n        List<String> rightKeys = Json.getStringList(req, \"rightKeys\");\n        Map<String, Object> opts = req.get(\"options\") instanceof Map m\n                ? castMap(m) : new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        HashJoinEngine.Config cfg = new HashJoinEngine.Config();\n        cfg.inMemoryRows = Json.optInt(opts, \"inMemoryRows\", cfg.inMemoryRows);\n        long budget = Json.optLong(opts, \"diskBudgetBytes\", Long.MAX_VALUE);\n        cfg.diskBudgetBytes = budget < 0 ? cfg.spillDir);\n\n        HashJoinEngine engine = new HashJoinEngine(left, right, type, leftKeys, rightKeys, cfg);\n        Map<String, Object> plan = engine.explain();\n        if (opts.get(\"planOutput\") instanceof Map po) {\n            writePlanFile(Path.of(Json.getString(castMap(po), \"path\")), plan, null);\n        }\n        return plan;\n    }\n\n    private static void writePlanFile(Path path, Map<String, Object> plan,\n                                      Map<String, Object> stats) {\n        Map<String, Object> doc = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        doc.put(\"plan\", plan);\n        if (stats != null) doc.put(\"stats\", stats);\n        try {\n            if (path.getParent() != null) Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());\n            Files.writeString(path, Json.writePretty(doc), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        } catch (IOException e) {\n            throw new JoinException(JoinException.IO_ERROR,\n                    \"Cannot write plan file: \" + path + \" (\" + e.getMessage() + \")\", e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static Map<String, Object> castMap(Map<?, ?> m) {\n        return (Map<String, Object>) m;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Table loading\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static Table parseTable(Map<String, Object> t) {\n        String name = Json.optString(t, \"name\", \"\");\n        List<String> columns = Json.getStringList(t, \"columns\");\n        List<Row> rows;\n        if (t.containsKey(\"file\")) {\n            if (!(t.get(\"file\") instanceof Map fm)) {\n                throw new JoinException(JoinException.INVALID_REQUEST, \"'file' must be an object\");\n            }\n            Map<String, Object> fo = castMap(fm);\n            Path path =          List<Object> rawRows = Json.getArray(t, \"rows\");\n            rows = new ArrayList<>(rawRows.size());\n            for (Object o : rawRows) rows.add(Row.ofRaw(asList(o)));\n        }\n        return new Table(name, new Schema(columns), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static List<Object> asList(Object o) {\n        if (!(o instanceof List<?> l)) {\n            throw new new ArrayList<>();\n        try {\n            if (format.equalsIgnoreCase(\"jsonl\")) {\n                for (String line : Files.readAllLines(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {\n                    if 'json'\");\n            }\n        } catch (IOException e) {\n            throw new JoinException(JoinException.IO_ERROR,\n                    \"Cannot read table file: \" + path + \" (\" + e.getMessage() + \")\", e);\n        }\n        for (Row r : rows) {\n            if (r.size() != width) {\n                throw new JoinException(JoinException.INVALID_REQUEST,\n    private static HashJoinEngine.Config cfg(Path tmp, int rows, long budget, int depth) {\n        HashJoinEngine.Config c = new HashJoinEngine.Config();\n        c.inMemoryRows = rows;\n        c.diskBudgetBytes = budget;\n        c.maxRepartitionDepth = depth;\n        c.spillDir = tmp.resolve(\"spill\").toString();\n        return c;\n    }\n\n    private static HashJoinEngine ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class ValueSemantics extends TestCase {\n        ValueSemantics() {\n            super(\"value equality/hash (numeric cross-type, type families)\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() {\n            check(Value.of(1L).equalsValue(Value.of(1.0d)), \"1L == 1.0d\");\n            check(Value.of(new BigDecimal(\"1.00\")).equalsValue(Value.of(1L)), \"1.00 == 1\");\n            check(Value.of(1.5d).equalsValue(Value.of(new BigDecimal(\"1.5\"))), \"1.5d == 1.5\");\n            check(!Value.of(1L).equalsValue(Value.of(\"1\")), \"1 != \\\"1\\\"\");\n            check(!Value.of(1L).equalsValue(Value.of(true)), \"1 != true\");\n            check(!Value.of(\"a\").equalsValue(Value.of(\"b\")), \"\\\"a\\\" != \\\"b\\\"\");\n            check(!Value.NULL.equalsValue(Value.NULL), \"NULL != NULL\");\n            check(!Value.NULL.equalsValue(Value.of(0L)), \"NULL != 0\");\n            eq(Value.of(1L).hashCode(), Value.of(1.0d).hashCode(), \"hash 1L/1.0d\");\n            eq(Value.of(new BigDecimal(\"1.00\")).hashCode(),\n                    Value.of(1L).hashCode(), \"hash 1.00/1\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // \"keys carry null flag\");\n            check(!k1.equals(k2), \"(1,NULL) must not equal (1,NULL)\");\n            var k3 = partjoin.Key.of(row(1, 2), i);\n            var k4 = partjoin.Key.of(row(1, 2), i);\n            check(k3.equals(k4) && k3.hashCode() == k4.hashCode(), \"(1,2) equals (1,2)\");\n            var k5 = partjoin.Key.of(row(null, 2), i);\n            check(!k5.equals(k4), ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class RandomCrossChecks extends TestCase {\n        private final Path tmp;\n\n        RandomCrossChecks(Path tmp) Exception {\n            long seed = 20260923L;\n            int scenarios = 0;\n            for (JoinType t : JoinType.values()) {\n                for (int mode = 0; mode < 3; mode++) {\n : 2;\n                    var pair = Data.randomPair(seed++, ln, rn, domain, 0.08, 1);\n                    var c = cfg(tmp, memRows, Long.MAX_VALUE, depth);\n                    var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n                    var eo = engine(pair, t, c).execute(out);\n                    var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(pair.left(), pair.right(), t, LK, RK);\n                    Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), expected,\n                            \"random \" + t + \" mode=\" + mode + \" seed scenario\");\n                    if (mode > 0)        }\n\n        private String runJava(Path cp, String stdin, String mainClass, String... args) throws Exception {\n            return runJavaCapture(cp, stdin, mainClass, args).stdout;\n        }\n\n        private ProcResult runJavaCapture(Path cp, String stdin, String mainClass, String... args)\n                throws Exception {\n            List<String> cmd = new ArrayList<>(List.of(\n                    System.getProperty(\"java.home\") + \"/bin/java\",\n                    \"-cp\", cp.toString(), mainClass));\n            cmd.addAll(List.of(args));\n            ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);\n            Process p = pb.start();\n            if (stdin != null) {\n                p.getOutputStream().write(stdin.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n                p.getOutputStream().close();\n            }\n            StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();\n            StringBuilder err = new StringBuilder();\n            try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream(),\n                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {\n                br.lines().forEach(l -> out.append(l).append('\\n'));\n            }\n            try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getErrorStream(),\n                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {\n                br.lines().forEach(l -> err.append(l).append('\\n'));\n            }\n            int code = p.waitFor();\n            return new ProcResult(code, out.toString(), err.toString());\n        }\n\n        record ProcResult(int exitCode, String stdout, String stderr) {\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_7eebdb7fd2c3e709791c7df2","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1183,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":83768,"output_tokens":7624,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_1ozebxboex1grnupzdxck0t6":{"content":"package   private static final List<String> LK = List.of(\"lk\");\n    private static final List<String> RK = List.of(\"rk\");\n    private static final List<String> LK2 = List.of(\"ka\", \"kb\");\n    private static final List<String> RK2 = List.of(\"ka\", \"kb\");\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {\n        Path tmp = Files.createTempDirectory(\"partjoin-tests\");\n t.unexpected().printStackTrace(System.out);\n        }\n        System.out.println(passed + \"/\" + tests.size() + \" test classes passed\");\n        System.exit(failed.isEmpty() ? 0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    private static HashJoinEngine.Config cfg(Path tmp, int rows, long budget, int depth) {\n        HashJoinEngine.Config c = new HashJoinEngine.Config();\n        c.inMemoryRows = rows;\n        c.diskBudgetBytes = budget;\n        c.maxRepartitionDepth = depth;\n        c.spillDir = tmp.resolve(\"spill\").toString();\n        return c;\n    }\n\n    private static HashJoinEngine engine(Data.TablePair p, JoinType t, HashJoinEngine.Config c) {\n        return new HashJoinEngine(p.left(), p.right(), t, LK, RK, c);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 1. value semantics: cross-type numeric equality, type-family separation\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class ValueSemantics extends TestCase {\n        ValueSemantics() {\n            super(\"value equality/hash (numeric cross-type, type families)\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() {\n            check(Value.of(1L).equalsValue(Value.of(1.0d)), \"1L == 1.0d\");\n            check(Value.of(new BigDecimal(\"1.00\")).equalsValue(Value.of(1L)), \"1.00 == 1\");\n            check(Value.of(1.5d).equalsValue(Value.of(new BigDecimal(\"1.5\"))), \"1.5d == 1.5\");\n            check(!Value.of(1L).equalsValue(Value.of(\"1\")), \"1 != \\\"1\\\"\");\n            check(!Value.of(1L).equalsValue(Value.of(true)), \"1 != true\");\n            check(!Value.of(\"a\").equalsValue(Value.of(\"b\")), \"\\\"a\\\" != \\\"b\\\"\");\n            check(!Value.NULL.equalsValue(Value.NULL), \"NULL != NULL\");\n            check(!Value.NULL.equalsValue(Value.of(0L)), \"NULL != 0\");\n            eq(Value.of(1L).hashCode(), Value.of(1.0d).hashCode(), \"hash 1L/1.0d\");\n            eq(Value.of(new BigDecimal(\"1.00\")).hashCode(),\n                    Value.of(1L).hashCode(), \"hash 1.00/1\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 2. composite key NULL semantics\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class KeyNullSemantics extends TestCase {\n        KeyNullSemantics() {\n            super(\"composite key NULL never matches\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() {\n            Schema s = Schema.of(\"ka\", \"kb\");\n            var i = s.indicesOf(List.of(\"ka\", \"kb\"));\n            var k1 = partjoin.Key.of(row(1, null), i);\n            var k2 = partjoin.Key.of(row(1, null), i);\n            check(k1.hasNull() && k2.hasNull(), \"keys carry null flag\");\n            check(!k1.equals(k2), \"(1,NULL) must not equal (1,NULL)\");\n            var k3 = partjoin.Key.of(row(1, 2), i);\n            var k4 = partjoin.Key.of(row(1, 2), i);\n            check(k3.equals(k4) && k3.hashCode() == k4.hashCode(), \"(1,2) equals (1,2)\");\n            var k5 = partjoin.Key.of(row(null, 2), i);\n            check(!k5.equals(k4), \"(NULL,2) != (1,2)\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 3. basic INNER in memory vs oracle\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class BasicInnerInMemory extends TestCase {\n        BasicInnerInMemory() {\n            super(\"basic INNER join, in-memory\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Table l = table(\"l\", Data.L2, List.of(row(1, 10), row(2, 20), row(3, 30), row(4, 20)));\n            Table r = table(\"r\", Data.R2,\n                    List.of(row(10, 10, \"a\"), row(11, 20, \"b\"), row(12, 99, \"c\")));\n            var c = cfg(Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj\"), 1024, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2);\n            var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n            var eo = new HashJoinEngine(l, r, JoinType.INNER, LK, RK, c).execute(out);\n            var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(l, r, JoinType.INNER, LK, RK);\n            Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), expected, \"basic inner\");\n            eq(out.rows().size(), 3, \"inner row count\");\n            eq(eo.stats.get(\"mode\"), \"IN_MEMORY\", \"mode\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 4. LEFT join null padding, unmatched and null keys\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class LeftJoinNullPadding extends TestCase {\n        LeftJoinNullPadding() {\n            super(\"LEFT join unmatched + null-key rows padded with NULLs\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Table l = table(\"l\", Data.L2, List.of(row(1, 10), row(2, 20), row(3, null), row(4, 40)));\n            Table r = table(\"r\", Data.R2, List.of(row(10, 10, \"a\"), row(11, 20, \"b\")));\n            var c = cfg(Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj\"), 1024, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2);\n            var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n            new HashJoinEngine(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, LK, RK, c).execute(out);\n            var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, LK, RK);\n            Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), expected, \"left null padding\");\n            eq(out.rows().size(), 4, \"left keeps all left rows\");\n            // row id=3 has null key -> unmatched padding\n            boolean nullPadded = out.rows().stream()\n                    .anyMatch(x -> x.get(0).raw().equals(3L)\n                            && x.get(2).isNull() && x.get(3).isNull() && x.get(4).isNull());\n            check(nullPadded, \"null-key left row padded with 3 nulls\");\n            boolean unmatched = out.rows().stream()\n                    .anyMatch(x -> x.get(0).raw().equals(4L) && x.get(2).isNull());\n            check(unmatched, \"unmatched left row padded\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 5. duplicates -> Cartesian product\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class DuplicatesCartesian extends TestCase {\n        DuplicatesCartesian() {\n            super(\"duplicate keys produce Cartesian product\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Table l = table(\"l\", Data.L2, List.of(row(1, 5), row(2, 5), row(3, 5)));\n            Table r = table(\"r\", Data.R2,\n                    List.of(row(1, 5, \"a\"), row(2, 5, \"b\"), row(3, 6, \"c\")));\n            var c = cfg(Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj\"), 1, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2); // force spill\n            var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n            var eo = new HashJoinEngine(l, r, JoinType.INNER, LK, RK, c).execute(out);\n            var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(l, r, JoinType.INNER, LK, RK);\n            Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), expected, \"duplicate cartesian\");\n            eq(out.rows().size(), 6, \"3 x 2 = 6 matches\");\n            eq(eo.stats.get(\"mode\"), \"PARTITIONED_SPILL\", \"spill forced\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 6. empty tables, all four combinations x both join types\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class EmptyTables extends TestCase {\n        EmptyTables() {\n            super(\"empty left / empty right for INNER and LEFT\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Table nonEmptyL = table(\"l\", Data.L2, List.of(row(1, 10), row(2, null)));\n            Table nonEmptyR = table(\"r\", Data.R2, List.of(row(1, 10, \"a\")));\n            Table emptyL = table(\"l\", Data.L2, List.of());\n            Table emptyR = table(\"r\", Data.R2, List.of());\n\n            for (JoinType t : JoinType.values()) {\n                cross(nonEmptyL, emptyR, t);\n                cross(emptyL, nonEmptyR, t);\n                cross(emptyL, emptyR, t);\n                cross(nonEmptyL, nonEmptyR, t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        private void cross(Table l, Table r, JoinType t) throws Exception {\n            var c = cfg(Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj\"), 1024, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2);\n            var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n            new HashJoinEngine(l, r, t, LK, RK, c).execute(out);\n            var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(l, r, t, LK, RK);\n            Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), expected,\n                    \"empty \" + t + \" l=\" + l.rowCount() + \" r=\" + r.rowCount());\n            // LEFT with empty right: every left row padded\n            if (t == JoinType.LEFT && r.rowCount() == 0) {\n                eq(out.rows().size(), l.rowCount(), \"left x empty-right row count\");\n                for (Row x : out.rows()) {\n                    for (int i = l.schema().size(); i < x.size(); i++) {\n                        check(x.get(i).isNull(), \"padding is null\");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 7. multi-column keys with NULL in each position\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class MultiColumnNulls extends TestCase {\n        MultiColumnNulls() {\n            super(\"multi-column keys, NULL in every key position\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Schema sl = Schema.of(\"id\", \"ka\", \"kb\", \"payload\");\n            Schema sr = Schema.of(\"rid\", \"ka\", \"kb\", \"rv\");\n            Table l = table(\"l\", sl, List.of(\n                    row(1, 1, 1, \"a\"),\n                    row(2, 1, null, \"b\"),\n                    row(3, null, 1, \"c\"),\n                    row(4, null, null, \"d\"),\n                    row(5, 2, 2, \"e\")));\n            Table r = table(\"r\", sr, List.of(\n                    row(10, 1, 1, \"A\"),\n                    row(11, 1, null, \"B\"),\n                    row(12, null, 1, \"C\"),\n                    row(13, 2, 2, \"D\"),\n                    row(14, 2, null, \"E\")));\n            var c = cfg(Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj\"), 2, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2); // force spill\n            for (JoinType t : JoinType.values()) {\n                var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n                new HashJoinEngine(l, r, t, LK2, RK2, c).execute(out);\n                var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(l, r, t, LK2, RK2);\n                Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), expected, \"multi-col \" + t);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 8. randomized multiset cross-checks across both modes\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class RandomCrossChecks extends TestCase {\n        private final Path tmp;\n\n        RandomCrossChecks(Path tmp) {\n            super(\"randomized data: engine multiset == nested-loop oracle (in-mem + spill)\");\n            this.tmp = tmp;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            long seed = 20260923L;\n            int scenarios = 0;\n            for (JoinType t : JoinType.values()) {\n                for (int mode = 0; mode < 3; mode++) {\n                    // 0: in-memory, 1: spill+leaf hash, 2: spill+repartition/fallback\n                    int ln = mode == 0 ? 50 : 900 + (int) (seed % 300);\n                    int rn = mode == 0 ? 40 : 800 + (int) (seed % 400);\n                    int domain = mode == 2 ? 20 : 500;\n                    int memRows = mode == 0 ? 1024 : (mode == 1 ? 128 : 64);\n                    int depth = mode == 2 ? 2 : 2;\n                    var pair = Data.randomPair(seed++, ln, rn, domain, 0.08, 1);\n                    var c = cfg(tmp, memRows, Long.MAX_VALUE, depth);\n                    var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n                    var eo = engine(pair, t, c).execute(out);\n                    var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(pair.left(), pair.right(), t, LK, RK);\n                    Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), expected,\n                            \"random \" + t + \" mode=\" + mode + \" seed scenario\");\n                    if (mode > 0) eq(eo.stats.get(\"mode\"), \"PARTITIONED_SPILL\", \"spill mode\");\n                    scenarios++;\n                }\n            }\n            check(scenarios == 6, \"ran 6 scenarios, ran=\" + scenarios);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 9. ALL hot keys through the bounded fallback (INNER)\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class AllHotKeyFallback extends TestCase {\n        AllHotKeyFallback() {\n            super(\"all-hot-key INNER: repartition cannot split, BNLJ fallback, full Cartesian\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Path tmp = Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj-hot\");\n            int ln = 3000, rn = 400;\n            var pair = Data.allHot(ln, rn);\n            var c = cfg(tmp, 64, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2);\n            var count = new RowCollector.CountingCollector();\n            var eo = engine(pair, JoinType.INNER, c).execute(count);\n            eq(count.count(), (long) ln * rn, \"all-hot cartesian row count\");\n            var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(pair.left(), pair.right(),\n                    JoinType.INNER, LK, RK);\n            eq((long) expected.size(), (long) ln * rn, \"oracle agrees\");\n            // repartitioning should have been attempted and failed to split,\n            // and the bounded fallback must have run\n            check(((Number) eo.stats.get(\"repartitions\")).longValue() >= 1,\n                    \"repartition attempted: \" + eo.stats.get(\"repartitions\"));\n            eq(((Number) eo.stats.get(\"fallbackBlockNestedLoops\")).longValue(), 1L,\n                    \"exactly one fallback\");\n            eq(eo.stats.get(\"mode\"), \"PARTITIONED_SPILL\", \"mode\");\n\n            // Multiset spot check with a smaller all-hot case (payloads distinguish rows).\n            var small = Data.allHot(300, 150);\n            var c2 = cfg(Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj-hot2\"), 16, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2);\n            var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n            engine(small, JoinType.INNER, c2).execute(out);\n            var exp = NestedLoopJoin.join(small.left(), small.right(), JoinType.INNER, LK, RK);\n            Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), exp, \"all-hot multiset\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 10. ALL hot keys LEFT through fallback: every left row matches\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class AllHotKeyLeftFallback extends TestCase {\n        AllHotKeyLeftFallback() {\n            super(\"all-hot-key LEFT via fallback + BNLJ marks every probe row\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Path tmp = Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj-hotleft\");\n            // left hot + a few unmatched/null rows interspersed\n            List<Row> ls = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Row> rs = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < 2500; i++) ls.add(row(i, 7, \"L\" + i));\n            ls.add(row(9001, 8, \"unmatched\"));\n            ls.add(row(9002, null, \"nullkey\"));\n            for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++) rs.add(row(i, 7, \"R\" + i));\n            Table l = table(\"l\", Schema.of(\"id\", \"lk\", \"lp\"), ls);\n            Table r = table(\"r\", Data.R2, rs);\n            var c = cfg(tmp, 64, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2);\n            var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n            var eo = new HashJoinEngine(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, LK, RK, c).execute(out);\n            var expected = NestedLoopJoin.join(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, LK, RK);\n            Multiset.assertEqualMultisets(out.rows(), expected, \"hot left multiset\");\n            eq(out.rows().size(), 2500L * 300 + 2, \"2500x300 matches + 2 unmatched\");\n            check(((Number) eo.stats.get(\"fallbackBlockNestedLoops\")).longValue() >= 1,\n                    \"fallback used\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 11. genuine repartition split: uniform large keys shrink, fallback NOT used\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class RepartitionGenuineSplit extends TestCase {\n        RepartitionGenuineSplit() {\n            super(\"uniform keys repartition into smaller partitions without fallback\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Path tmp = 0; i < ln; i++) ls.add(row(i, i, \"L\" + i));\n            for (int i = 0; i < rn; i++) rs.add(row(i, i, \"R\" + i));\n            Table l = table(\"l\", Schema.of(\"id\", \"lk\", \"lp\"), ls);\n            Table r = table(\"r\", Data.R2, rs);\n            var c = cfg(tmp, 32, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2);\n            var out = new RowCollector.ListCollector();\n            var eo = new HashJoinEngine(l, r, (Row x : out.rows()) {\n                eq(x.get(0).raw(), x.get(2).raw(), \"matching ids paired\");\n            }\n            eq(((Number) eo.stats.get(\"fallbackBlockNestedLoops\")).longValue(), 0L,\n                    \"no fallback for uniform keys\");\n            check(((Number) eo.stats.get(\"repartitions\")).longValue() >= 1,\n                    \"repartition happened: \" + eo.stats.get(\"repartitions\"));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 12. disk budget exhausted -> DISK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, spill dir cleaned\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    static final class DiskBudgetExhausted extends TestCase {\n        private final Path tmp;\n\n        DiskBudgetExhausted(Path tmp) {\n            super(\"disk quota exhausted raises DISK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and cleans up\");\n            this.tmp = tmp;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() throws Exception {\n            Path spill = tmp.resolve(\"budget-spill\");\n            var pair = Data.allHot(5000, 5000);\n            var c = cfg(spill, 64, 2048, 2);\n            var count = new RowCollector.CountingCollector();\n            JoinException ex = null;\n            try {\n                engine(pair, JoinType.INNER, c).execute(count);\n            } catch (JoinException e) {\n                ex = e;\n            }\n            check(ex != null, \"budget exception thrown\");\n            eq(ex.code(), JoinException.DISK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, \"error code\");\n            eq(count.count(), 0, \"no output before the initial spill completes\");\n            // spill root must be gone (cleanup in finally)\n            check(!Files.exists(spill) || isEmptyDir(spill),\n                    \"spill directory removed after failure: \" + spill);\n        }\n\n        private static boolean isEmptyDir(Path p) throws Exception {\n            if (!Files.isDirectory(p)) return false;\n            try (var s = Files.list(p)) {\n                return s.findAny().isEmpty();\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // JSON round trip (parser/writer fidelity incl. super(\"JSON parse/write fidelity\");\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        protected void run() {\n            String text = \"{\\\"a\\\":1,\\\"b\\\":1.50,\\\"big\\\":99999999999999999999,\"\n                    + \"\\\"neg\\\":-7,\\\"s\\\":\\\"x\\\\n\\\\u00e9\\\",\\\"t\\\":true,\\\"f\\\":false,\"\n                    + \"\\\"n\\\":null,\\\"arr\\\":[1,2,3.25,\\\"q\\\"]}\";\n            Map<String, Object> m = Json.parseObject(text);\n            eq(m.get(\"a\"), 1L, \"int -> Long\");\n            check(m.get(\"b\") instanceof BigDecimal && ((BigDecimal) m.get(\"b\")).signum() > 0,\n                    \"decimal -> BigDecimal\");\n            eq(m.get(\"s\"), \"x\\n\" + \"é\", \"escapes/unicode\");\n            check(m.get(\"n\") == null, \"null\");\n            String again = string\");\n            // malformed input must be rejected\n            boolean threw = false;\n            try {\n                Json.parse(\"{bad\");\n            } catch (JoinException e) {\n Data.randomPair(1, 10, 10, 5, 0, 0);\n            var c = cfg(Files.createTempDirectory(\"pj-plan\"), 1024, Long.MAX_VALUE, 2);\n            var plan = new HashJoinEngine(small.left(), small.right(), {"parentUuid":"a67a865a-fa42-483d-8351-9c59f09607a4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_r93p4dk9a10qty064npowm38","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/b/README.md","content":"# 分区哈希连接（Partitioned Hash Join）— 单机内存查询引擎\n\n纯后端、零第三方依赖的 Java 单机查询引擎。核心连接运算（哈希、分区、落盘、\n回退）全部手写，**不调用任何现成 SQL 引擎**。通过 JSON 请求驱动，支持执行计划\n与结果数据导出。\n\n## 功能范围\n\n- **连接类型**：`INNER`（内连接）、`LEFT`（左外连接）。\n- **多列连接键**：任意列数的复合键。\n- **NULL 语义（SQL 标准）**：键中任一列是 NULL 即“空键行”，NULL 永不等于任何值\n  （也不等于另一个 NULL）。INNER 丢弃两侧空键行；LEFT 将未匹配（含空键）的左行\n  以右侧全 NULL 补齐输出。\n- **重复键笛卡尔积**：构建侧每个键保存桶列表，每个探测行与桶内全部构建行配对，\n  自然产生重复键的多重集笛卡尔积。\n- **超内存阈值分区落盘**：两侧任一超过 `inMemoryRows` 即进入分区模式，按深度加盐\n  哈希将两侧写为成对的磁盘分区文件，再逐对处理。\n- **热点分区处理**：\n  - 构建侧仍超过阈值且重分区深度未到上限 → 用**新的哈希种子递归再分区**\n    （均匀键会被拆开；单一热点键哈希后仍在同一块，拆不开）；\n  - 达到深度上限后 → **有界块嵌套循环回退（bounded block-nested-loops）**：\n    构建侧与探测侧都按不超过 `inMemoryRows` 行的块流式扫描，峰值驻留内存有界，\n    因此全热点键（所有行同一个键）无论多大都能算完。\n- **磁盘额度**：`diskBudgetBytes` 实时计费，每次写入前检查；超限立即失败并返回\n  `DISK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`，临时目录自动清理。\n- **导出**：结果可直接内联在响应中，或以 JSONL / JSON 数组写文件；执行计划可单独\n  导出（`plan` 子命令只做计划不执行，也可随运行一并导出）。\n- **表数据来源**：请求内联 `rows`，或 `file` 引用外部 JSONL / JSON 文件。\n\n## 环境与构建\n\n- 需要 JDK 17+（仅用 `javac`/`java`，无需 Maven/Gradle，无外部依赖）。\n\n```bash\n./build.sh          # 编译主代码与测试 -> build/classes, build/test-classes\n./test.sh           # 运行自动化测试套件\n./run.sh <请求.json> [响应文件.json]   # 执行一次连接\n./run.sh plan <请求.json>              # 只输出执行计划\ncat req.json | ./run.sh -              # 从标准输入读取请求\n```\n\n退出码：`0` 成功；`2` 连接/请求错误（stderr 输出 `{\"ok\":false,\"error\":{...}}`）；\n`1` 用法或本地 IO 错误。\n\n## 请求格式\n\n```json\n{\n  \"joinType\": \"INNER | LEFT\",\n  \"left\":  {\n    \"name\": \"t1\",\n    \"columns\": [\"k\", \"a\"],\n    \"rows\": [[1, \"x\"], [2, null]]\n  },\n  \"right\": {\n    \"name\": \"t2\",\n    \"columns\": [\"k\", \"b\"],\n    \"file\": {\"path\": \"data/t2.jsonl\", \"format\": \"jsonl\"}\n  },\n  \"leftKeys\": [\"k\"],\n  \"rightKeys\": [\"k\"],\n  \"options\": {\n    \"inMemoryRows\": 1024,\n    \"diskBudgetBytes\": -1,\n    \"maxRepartitionDepth\": 2,\n    \"spillDir\": \"/tmp/partjoin-spill\",\n    \"maxInlineRows\": 10000,\n    \"output\": {\"path\": \"out/result.jsonl\", \"format\": \"jsonl\"},\n    \"planOutput\": {\"path\": \"out/plan.json\"}\n  }\n}\n```\n\n选项说明：\n\n| 选项 | 默认 | 含义 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `inMemoryRows` | 1024 | 单侧驻留内存的行数阈值；也是回退算法的分块大小 |\n| `diskBudgetBytes` | 无限（`-1`） | 落盘临时文件的实时字节额度，超限报错 |\n| `maxRepartitionDepth` | 2 | 递归再分区最大深度，超过后走块嵌套循环回退 |\n| `spillDir` | 系统临时目录下 | 落盘根目录，每次运行在其下建唯一 UUID 子目录，结束即删 |\n| `maxInlineRows` | 10000 | 不导出文件时响应中内联返回的最大行数（其余仅计数） |\n| `output` | 无 | `{path, format: jsonl|json}`，结果流式写文件 |\n| `planOutput` | 无 | 计划（及随运行的统计）写文件 |\n\n输出列顺序固定为 **左表全部列 + 右表全部列**；LEFT 未匹配行右侧补 NULL。\n\n值类型与 SQL 风格相等规则：整数/浮点/十进制按**数值**比较（`1 = 1.0 = 1.00`），\n字符串 `\"1\"` 不等于数字 `1`，布尔与数字互不相等。\n\n## 算法说明\n\n1. **空表短路**：右表为空时 INNER 无输出、LEFT 输出全部左行补 NULL；左表为空无输出。\n2. **小输入**：两侧都 ≤ `inMemoryRows` 时直接内存哈希连接（INNER 用较小侧建表，\n   LEFT 固定右内表建表，用位图记录已匹配的左行）。\n3. **分区**：复合键先做逐组件的值哈希（数字归一化），再用深度加盐的 murmur3 风格\n   混合函数取模分桶；fanout 按较大侧行数 / 阈值 × 1.3 估算，夹在 [4, 64]。\n   空键行不进分区。左右两侧用相同哈希函数保证同键同行落同桶。\n4. **逐桶处理**：桶对独立处理。INNER 在桶内仍允许选较小侧建表；LEFT 固定右侧建表\n   以便用左行原始行号位图记录匹配。\n5. **再分区/回退**：构建侧过大则递归再分区（深度 +1、换新种子）；深度耗尽走双侧\n   分块的块嵌套循环，内存有界。\n6. **落盘格式**：JSONL，每行 `{\"row\":[...],\"id\":<左行原始序号或 -1>}`；所有字节\n   计入额度。\n\n统计字段（响应 `stats`）：`mode`、输入/输出行数、两侧空键行数、创建/处理的分区数、\n达到的最大再分区深度、再分区次数、回退次数、落盘文件数与累计字节数。\n\n## 正确性验证\n\n测试不使用 JUnit，自带极简断言框架。**核心做法是与独立的嵌套循环参考实现\n（`NestedLoopJoin`）逐对比较键、按 JSON 规范化后比较输出多重集**（按行内容计频次，\n而非只看行数）。覆盖：\n\n- 值相等/哈希（跨类型数字、类型族隔离）、复合键 NULL 永不匹配；\n- 基础 INNER / LEFT 补 NULL / 重复键笛卡尔积；\n- 空表（左右四种组合 × 两种连接）、多列键各位置含 NULL；\n- 多组随机数据（含 8% NULL、小键域制造重复）下内存与落盘模式对比参考实现；\n- **全热点键** INNER 与 LEFT（3000×400 / 2500 热点 + 未匹配 + 空键）走回退，验证\n  完整笛卡尔积与位图标记；\n- 热点键 + 大量均匀键混合（回退与再分区并存）；\n- 均匀大键被真正拆开（50k×50k，零回退）及 5 万级冒烟计时；\n- **磁盘额度耗尽**：错误码、零输出、临时文件全部清理；\n- JSON 解析/写入保真、计划接口、CLI 端到端（stdin、plan、额度失败退出码 2）。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\nsrc/main/java/partjoin/\n  Main.java            JSON 命令行入口（无 HTTP 服务）\n  RequestRunner.java   请求解析、表加载、执行与响应/导出\n  HashJoinEngine.java  分区哈希连接、递归再分区、块嵌套循环回退、统计\n  NestedLoopJoin.java  嵌套循环参考实现（测试预言机）\n  Spiller.java         落盘文件管理与磁盘额度计费\n  Value/Row/Key/Schema/Table/JoinType/JoinException.java  数据模型\n  Json.java            零依赖 JSON 解析/序列化\n  RowCollector.java    内联/计数/流式文件输出收集器\nsrc/test/java/partjoin/test/  自动化测试（17 个测试类）\nexamples/                请求样例与外部数据样例\nbuild.sh test.sh run.sh  构建/测试/运行脚本\nRUNLOG.md                实际运行命令与结果记录\n```\n\n## 限制（非目标）\n\n- 无前端、无 HTTP server；入口是进程 + JSON（stdin 或文件）。\n- 非等值连接、聚合、排序、投影裁剪、UPDATE/DELETE 等不在范围内。\n- 内存计量以“行数阈值 + 分块”保证驻留有界，不做逐字节 JVM 堆核算；磁盘额度按\n 分区哈希连接（Partitioned Hash Join）— 单机内存查询引擎\n\n纯后端、零第三方依赖的 Java 单机查询引擎。核心连接运算（哈希、分区、落盘、\n回退）全部手写，**不调用任何现成 SQL 引擎**。通过 JSON 请求驱动，支持执行计划\n与结果数据导出。\n\n## 功能范围\n\n- **连接类型**：`INNER`（内连接）、`LEFT`（左外连接）。\n- **多列连接键**：任意列数的复合键。\n- **NULL 语义（SQL 标准）**：键中任一列是 NULL 即“空键行”，NULL 永不等于任何值\n  （也不等于另一个 NULL）。INNER 丢弃两侧空键行；LEFT 将未匹配（含空键）的左行\n  以右侧全 NULL 补齐输出。\n- **重复键笛卡尔积**：构建侧每个键保存桶列表，每个探测行与桶内全部构建行配对，\n  自然产生重复键的多重集笛卡尔积。\n- **超内存阈值分区落盘**：两侧任一超过 `inMemoryRows` 即进入分区模式，按深度加盐\n  哈希将两侧写为成对的磁盘分区文件，再逐对处理。\n- **热点分区处理**：\n  - 构建侧仍超过阈值且重分区深度未到上限 → 用**新的哈希种子递归再分区**\n    （均匀键会被拆开；单一热点键哈希后仍在同一块，拆不开）；\n  - 达到深度上限后 → **有界块嵌套循环回退（bounded block-nested-loops）**：\n    构建侧与探测侧都按不超过 `inMemoryRows` 行的块流式扫描，峰值驻留内存有界，\n    因此全热点键（所有行同一个键）无论多大都能算完。\n- **磁盘额度**：`diskBudgetBytes` 实时计费，每次写入前检查；超限立即失败并返回\n `DISK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`，临时目录自动清理。\n- **导出**：结果可直接内联在响应中，或以 JSONL / JSON 数组写文件；执行计划可单独\n  导出（`plan` 子命令只做计划不执行，也可随运行一并导出）。\n- **表数据来源**：请求内联 `rows`，或 `file` 引用外部 JSONL / JSON 文件。\n\n## 环境与构建\n\n- 需要 JDK 17+（仅用 `javac`/`java`，无需 Maven/Gradle，无外部依赖）。\n\n```bash\n./build.sh          # 编译主代码与测试 -> build/classes, build/test-classes\n./test.sh           # 运行自动化测试套件\n./run.sh <请求.json> [响应文件.json]   # 执行一次连接\n./run.sh plan <请求.json>              # 只输出执行计划\ncat req.json | ./run.sh -              # 从标准输入读取请求\n```\n\n退出码：`0` 成功；`2` 连接/请求错误（stderr 输出 `{\"ok\":false,\"error\":{...}}`）；\n`1` 用法或本地 IO 错误。\n\n## 请求格式\n\n```json\n{\n  \"joinType\": \"INNER | LEFT\",\n  \"left\":  {\n    \"name\": \"t1\",\n    \"columns\": [\"k\", \"a\"],\n    \"rows\": [[1, \"x\"], [2, null]]\n  },\n  \"right\": {\n    \"name\": \"t2\",\n    \"columns\": [\"k\", \"b\"],\n    \"file\": {\"path\": \"data/t2.jsonl\", \"format\": \"jsonl\"}\n  },\n  \"leftKeys\": [\"k\"],\n  \"rightKeys\": [\"k\"],\n  \"options\": {\n    \"inMemoryRows\": 1024,\n    \"diskBudgetBytes\": -1,\n    \"maxRepartitionDepth\": 2,\n    \"spillDir\": \"/tmp/partjoin-spill\",\n    \"maxInlineRows\": 10000,\n    \"output\": {\"path\": \"out/result.jsonl\", \"format\": \"jsonl\"},\n    \"planOutput\": {\"path\": \"out/plan.json\"}\n  }\n}\n```\n\n选项说明：\n\n| 选项 | 默认 | 含义 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `inMemoryRows` | 1024 | 单侧驻留内存的行数阈值；也是回退算法的分块大小 |\n| `diskBudgetBytes` | 无限（`-1`） | 落盘临时文件的实时字节额度，超限报错 |\n| `maxRepartitionDepth` | 2 | 递归再分区最大深度，超过后走块嵌套循环回退 |\n| `spillDir` | 系统临时目录下 | 落盘根目录，每次运行在其下建唯一 UUID 子目录，结束即删 |\n| `maxInlineRows` | 10000 | 不导出文件时响应中内联返回的最大行数（其余仅计数） |\n| `output` | 无 | `{path, format: jsonl|json}`，结果流式写文件 |\n| `planOutput` | 无 | 计划（及随运行的统计）写文件 |\n\n输出列顺序固定为 **左表全部列 + 右表全部列**；LEFT 未匹配行右侧补 NULL。\n\n值类型与 SQL 风格相等规则：整数/浮点/十进制按**数值**比较（`1 = 1.0 = 1.00`），\n字符串 `\"1\"` 不等于数字 `1`，布尔与数字互不相等。\n\n## 算法说明\n\n1. **空表短路**：右表为空时 INNER 无输出、LEFT 输出全部左行补 NULL；左表为空无输出。\n2. **小输入**：两侧都 ≤ `inMemoryRows` 时直接内存哈希连接（INNER 用较小侧建表，\n   LEFT 固定右内表建表，用位图记录已匹配的左行）。\n3. **分区**：复合键先做逐组件的值哈希（数字归一化），再用深度加盐的 murmur3 风格\n   混合函数取模分桶；fanout 按较大侧行数 / 阈值 × 1.3 估算，夹在 [4, 64]。\n   空键行不进分区。左右两侧用相同哈希函数保证同键同行落同桶。\n4. **逐桶处理**：桶对独立处理。INNER 在桶内仍允许选较小侧建表；LEFT 固定右侧建表\n   以便用左行原始行号位图记录匹配。\n5. **再分区/回退**：构建侧过大则递归再分区（深度 +1、换新种子）；深度耗尽走双侧\n   分块的块嵌套循环，内存有界。\n6. **落盘格式**：JSONL，每行 `{\"row\":[...],\"id\":<左行原始序号或 -1>}`；所有字节\n   计入额度。\n\n统计字段（响应 `stats`）：`mode`、输入/输出行数、两侧空键行数、创建/处理的分区数、\n达到的最大再分区深度、再分区次数、回退次数、落盘文件数与累计字节数。\n\n## 正确性验证\n\n测试不使用 JUnit，自带极简断言框架。**核心做法是与独立的嵌套循环参考实现\n（`NestedLoopJoin`）逐对比较键、按 JSON 规范化后比较输出多重集**（按行内容计频次，\n而非只看行数）。覆盖：\n\n- 值相等/哈希（跨类型数字、类型族隔离）、复合键 NULL 永不匹配；\n- 基础 INNER / LEFT 补 NULL / 重复键笛卡尔积；\n- 空表（左右四种组合 × 两种连接）、多列键各位置含 NULL；\n- 多组随机数据（含 8% NULL、小键域制造重复）下内存与落盘模式对比参考实现；\n- **全热点键** INNER 与 LEFT（3000×400 / 2500 热点 + 未匹配 + 空键）走回退，验证\n  完整笛卡尔积与位图标记；\n- 热点键 + 大量均匀键混合（回退与再分区并存）；\n- 均匀大键被真正拆开（50k×50k，零回退）及 5 万级冒烟计时；\n- **磁盘额度耗尽**：错误码、零输出、临时文件全部清理；\n- JSON 解析/写入保真、计划接口、CLI 端到端（stdin、plan、额度失败退出码 2）。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\nsrc/main/java/partjoin/\n  Main.java            JSON 命令行入口（无 HTTP 服务）\n  RequestRunner.java   请求解析、表加载、执行与响应/导出\n  HashJoinEngine.java  分区哈希连接、递归再分区、块嵌套循环回退、统计\n  NestedLoopJoin.java  嵌套循环参考实现（测试预言机）\n  Spiller.java         落盘文件管理与磁盘额度计费\n  Value/Row/Key/Schema/Table/JoinType/JoinException.java  数据模型\n  Json.java            零依赖 JSON 解析/序列化\n  RowCollector.java    内联/计数/流式文件输出收集器\nsrc/test/java/partjoin/test/  自动化测试（17 个测试类）\nexamples/                请求样例与外部数据样例\nbuild.sh test.sh run.sh  构建/测试/运行脚本\nRUNLOG.md                实际运行命令与结果记录\n```\n\n## 限制（非目标）\n\n- 无前端、无 HTTP server；入口是进程 + JSON（stdin 或文件）。\n- 非等值连接、聚合、排序、投影裁剪、UPDATE/DELETE 等不在范围内。\n- 内存计量以“行数阈值 + 分块”保证驻留有界，不做逐字节 JVM 堆核算；磁盘额度按\n  落盘字节精确计费。\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ea995a1e-4a22-46c9-9098-0aef7560686c","session_id":"141270ed-bd67-4d73-9ed2-5fe1b950e0ba","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/b","sessionId":"141270ed-bd67-4d73-9ed2-5fe1b950e0ba","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-b","slug":"encapsulated-skipping-hammock"}
